detailed_description:
LOCATION MAP: The crossroads of two muddy roads in open winter pasture. THE TREE, a single ancient leafless oak, stands at the right-hand front corner of the crossroads; its thick LOW LIMB runs almost horizontally out over the verge toward the centre of the crossroads. A rough LADDER leans against the trunk on the road side. The low HITCHING POST stands in the same verge a few paces from the trunk. At the foot of the tree, among the huge knuckled ROOTS, the earth is black, soft and bare. THE BACK ROAD enters at the far left round a BEND hidden by a bare thorn HEDGE; THE ROAD AHEAD leaves to the right, straight, long and open; THE OPPOSITE ROAD comes down toward us from a low bare HILL far behind. Nothing else stands in the open fields. Camera side: the camera stands on the back-road side of the crossroads, looking toward the tree, which stays at frame-right. The 180° line is the line between the bend in the hedge and the tree; the camera stays on its side of that line.

ACTION TIMING:
[0.00s–7.00s] [[ACTION]]
Nobody speaks in this shot.
PEOPLE: ANCEL: a thin man around fifty with a long narrow face, sunken cheeks, a shaved tonsure with a ring of short grey hair, pale light-brown eyes, a long thin nose, chapped lips, no beard but two days of grey stubble; he wears an undyed brown wool habit, patched and hitched up at the belt for walking, a leather satchel on a strap across his chest, and a small dull lead pendant on a cord at his neck; no weapon; ink stains on the fingers of his right hand.
CHARACTER ACTING: ANCEL answers Odila with a small tired kindness, the way one humours village belief, and means it. Kneeling at the satchels he searches like an army clerk: bread, flint, silver put back where it was. From the oilcloth he draws a small wooden-boarded book, opens it anywhere, and reads two lines with moving lips. He closes it and stays perfectly still, hands closed around it, then wraps it again, ties the cord and slides it into his own satchel as if it were nothing.
PHYSICS: Real weight: feet sink into soft mud and crack frozen ruts, breath steams, cloth and gear move with the body; any animal already in the first frame shifts its weight and blows.
LIGHTING: Early winter afternoon under a low, even overcast sky: flat, cold grey light with no sun and no hard shadows, frost in the wheel ruts, breath visible; the light falls slowly as the scene goes on.
STYLE: Photorealistic live-action medieval drama, thirteenth century, grounded and naturalistic, in open northern European farmland; muted desaturated palette, aged mud-stained costumes, no fantasy.
QUALITY: Photorealistic from frame zero; identities, costumes and animals consistent across the whole take; natural motion blur; no morphing.
